faq_a1: Paste your API Key in the credential input at the top. This tool uses AIHubMix as the default engine. Sign in at aihubmix.com → create a key → paste it → enter a prompt → generate. You can also set AIHUBMIX_KEY in your .env.
faq_a2: Three engines: ① AIHubMix (paid) — GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro/2, Seedream 5.0 Pro, FLUX Kontext, Z-Image Turbo. Alipay/WeChat accepted. ② Hugging Face (free) — open SDXL/SD models, zero cost. ③ Pollinations (best value) — Flux from 0.0018 pollen/image, Alipay supported.
faq_a3: Both AIHubMix and Pollinations are pay-as-you-go with no subscriptions. Both support Alipay (from ~¥10). AIHubMix: ¥0.05-2 per image. Pollinations: 0.0001-0.12 pollen per image (1 pollen ≈ $0.01).
faq_a4: Switch to the Image-to-Image tab, upload a reference image (click / drag-drop / paste), describe the changes, and click Generate. Supports AIHubMix and Pollinations engines.
faq_a5: The ✦ Studio tab provides 4 scene templates for advanced editing: ① Edit — change specific details while keeping everything else. ② Outfit Swap — combine two images (outfit from A, person from B). ③ Fusion — blend two images. ④ Background — keep subject, replace background. Best with Nano Banana Pro.
faq_a6: Your key is stored in your browser's localStorage and sent to your local server only — never to any third party. Keys in .env are protected by .gitignore and never committed.
